scripts.start: npm run docker:up:optional && npm run start:info && npm run start:app
scripts.start:full: npm run docker:up && npm run start:info && npm run start:app
scripts.docker:up:optional: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { docker compose up -d; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'Docker is installed but not running. Starting app without containers.' } } else { Write-Host 'Docker not found. Starting app without containers.' }"
